name: GENERAL STORE INTERIOR
text: This small shop seems to sell a bit of
everything, from preserved foods to spare
parts. The glow from the cooler cuts through
the dim lighting, illuminating a surprisingly

name: ILLUMINATED GLASS COOLER
text: The bright orange light from within makes the
bottled drinks and packaged goods look almost
unearthly. It hums with a quiet, steady energy
that keeps everything chilled.

name: RUSTING EXPOSED PIPES
text: These thick metal pipes run along the wall,
showing signs of heavy rust and wear. They
seem to be part of the building's aging
infrastructure.

name: WOODEN PRODUCE RACK
text: This tiered wooden stand holds fresh, colorful
vegetables. The bright reds and greens are a
welcome sight in the otherwise drab shop.

name: CEILING MOUNTED WIRES
text: A bundle of dark cables runs along the
ceiling, secured in places but sagging
slightly. They look like they carry power or
data to different parts of the store.

name: EXPOSED WALL PIPING
text: These pipes route down from the ceiling and
along the wall. They are a common sight in
these older, repurposed structures.

name: LARGE METAL BARREL
text: This green, heavy-duty barrel sits securely in
the corner. Its purpose is unclear, but it
looks sturdy enough to hold liquids or bulk
materials.

name: VINTAGE CASH REGISTER
text: This older model register sits on the counter,
likely used for keeping track of the day's
sales. It looks well-maintained despite its
age.

name: PAPER GROCERY BAG
text: A simple brown paper bag rests on the shelf,
holding something bulky. It's a modest,
practical container for dry goods.

name: STACKED CARDBOARD BOXES
text: These plain brown boxes are stacked neatly by
the counter. They might contain extra stock or
deliveries waiting to be unpacked.

name: WOODEN PRODUCE CRATE
text: This sturdy wooden crate is filled with what
looks like fresh, green produce. It's
practical storage for items that need to stay
cool and dry.

name: SMALL WOODEN STOOL
text: A simple, well-worn stool sits behind the
counter. It provides a spot for the shopkeeper
to rest during a long day.

name: RIBBED METAL BARREL
text: This grey metal barrel is tucked under the
shelving unit. It looks like it could hold a
significant amount of supplies or waste.

name: WOODEN STORAGE CRATE
text: This wooden crate is full of pale, root-like
vegetables. It's a simple, effective way to
display and store bulk goods.
